newsitem.title: USA: Orange County, Fla., property value rises 8.63 pct.
newsitem.headline: Orange County, Fla., property value rises 8.63 pct.

text.p: The total value of property in Florida's Orange County rose 8.63 percent or $3.2 billion over the year to $40 billion, largely due to tourism-related construction, Property Appraiser Rich Crotty said.
About $1.2 billion of the increase was due to new construction.
Crotty said the county's property value has nearly doubled in 10 years and should continue to climb as Walt Disney World and Universal Studios Florida finish major expanion projects.
This year's increase will add about $4.9 million of unexpected property tax revenue to the county's budget.
